title: Intelligentie en schoolloopbaan 1979-1980
authors: Nijsse, M., Rijksuniversiteit Groningen * Groningen, Vakgroep orthopedagogiek (primary investigator)
descriptions: Research of the predictive validity of the ISI- and Galo-test for choice of school and school-career in the types of school specified by the 'mammoetwet' ( law on the organization of education in the Netherlands ). Test items and report marks. Background variables: basic characteristics/ occupation/employment
